chunks.text: Dear students, Welcome to GITsmeasures

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: In today's video I am going to explain the difference between linear regression and logistic regression

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Students often predict values in regression, they predict numeric values

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So it seems that both of these are used to predict numeric values

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: But let me tell you that even though their name is same, but there is a major difference between them

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Some things are similar but some things are different

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So I will tell you all the stories

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Linear regression and logistic regression both are there in supervised learning

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: But in supervised also you have two categories, one is classification and other is regression

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So this linear is used in regression model where we predict values, numeric values

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: And here we do classification where we predict the class, that from which class it belongs

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Simplest example is email, that this particular email is spam or not

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: If I give you this symptom of disease, then will there be disease or not

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Will there be fever or not, will student pass or student fail

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Means whenever we are doing this category, this classification comes under this

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: And whenever we are predicting values like if I talk about stock price

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: That this particular company has stock prices, let's suppose I say what will be the price after 6 months

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So they are actually predicting a value or let's suppose it is house price

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: If I predict house price according to the size of the house, then what will happen

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Let's suppose if the house is of 100 sq.ft. 200, 300, 400, 500 and what will be the prices here

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: There will be no category, yes or no, what will happen, price will be a value

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: 1000, 1 lakh, 2 lakh, 5 lakh, 10 lakh, 20 lakh, kind of a continuous data will be there in it

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So just keep this in mind, here also independent variable is dependent variable

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Here also independent and dependent variable is there

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Independent variable here also helps in predicting in both cases

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: And dependent variable is that which we predict

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Now here the independent variable is continuous, here also it is continuous

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: But the data of dependent variable is continuous here but here it is discrete

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: What happens? It is category based in the form of discrete 0 or 1

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: The same simplest example, if I talk here, if I see the price here, like house price

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: House's let's suppose size and price, now see here if I take the size of the house

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So what is this value? Continuous kind of anything, like this we are taking some data

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: There is no category in the form of 0 or 1 and what will be the price like this

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Let's suppose it is 1 lakh or 2 lakh or 5 lakh or 6 lakh or 10 lakh, any value like this

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: But the value in our logistic will be category based

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Category means yes or no, means either value 0 or value 1

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: In this way the value is category based in logistic

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Now here the equation of linear regression is y is equal to a0 plus a1 x1

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: What is this x1 here? Independent variable, what is this? Dependent

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: I have already told you all the stories how linear regression works

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: I have explained you with example, you will get the link in the description box also in the i section

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: I have explained the whole story of logistic regression with example, you will get its link in the i section also

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So first read about it, you will understand half of the story there

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Now this is your intercept, a1 is your coefficient that if I change x value then how much y value is increasing

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: And here this is sigmoid, this is your sigmoid function

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: According to sigmoid function we calculate the value, here we calculate according to linear

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Because here we are assuming that values are linearly independent

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: But the values here are actually category based

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: So if I have continuous data then I put it in sigmoid function and bring it between 0 and 1

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: This y, you know what it does? It checks the value of my x and brings every output in the category of 0 or 1

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: And then predicts that which class it will come in

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Here we predict the value in the form of 0 or 1, in the form of numeric value

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: This is the major difference between logistic and linear regression

chunks.title: Linear Regression Vs
chunks.text: Thank You
